name: Create Chat Invite Link
description: Create an additional invite link for a chat, [See the docs](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#createchatinvitelink) for more information

configurable_props.name: chatId
configurable_props.label: Chat ID
configurable_props.description: Enter the unique identifier for the target chat (e.g. `1035597319`) or username of the target public chat (in the format `@channelusername` or `@supergroupusername`). For example, if the group's public link is `t.me/mygroup`, the username is `@mygroup`.

configurable_props.name: expire_date
configurable_props.label: Invite link expire date
configurable_props.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the link will expire, in [unix time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time) (e.g. `1567780450`).

configurable_props.name: member_limit
configurable_props.label: Maximum number of users
configurable_props.description: Maximum number of users that can be members of the chat simultaneously after joining the chat via this invite link; 1-99999

configurable_props.name: creates_join_request
configurable_props.label: Creates join request
configurable_props.description: True, if users joining the chat via the link need to be approved by chat administrators. If True, member_limit can't be specified
